text:
Olivia Park: Hi team! Starting today. Quick onboarding security q: my Mac was shipped but MDM shows 'compliance: noncompliant' and the training portal lists a phishing sim scheduled already. Can I still access Slack and GitHub while this is unresolved? Also can I enroll my personal Pixel phone for Duo or do we require company phones? Who do I flag for urgent help?

Priya Kapoor: Welcome Olivia! :wave: You should be able to access Slack and non-sensitive internal docs while ticket is open, but access to sensitive repos may be blocked until MDM/compliance is resolved. Personal Pixel is allowed for Duo if it meets lockscreen and encryption requirements; we prefer company devices for corporate GitHub. For urgent help ping @IT Help or open ticket with priority 'onboarding'.

IT Help: Olivia, can you paste the MDM compliance error? If it's missing Jamf profile or security setting, run `profiles status -type enrollment` and attach the output. We can push a remediation policy once we confirm the error.

Olivia Park: profiles output: "MDM enrollment: Enrolled
Compliance: noncompliant
Missing profile: VPNConfig"

Marcus Hale: That looks like the VPNConfig profile failed to install. Sometimes network restrictions block the install during initial setup. Try connecting to the office VPN manually or switch to a mobile hotspot for a minute and re-run Jamf. I'll stand by if you want remote help.

Olivia Park: I can switch to hotspot now. Quick aside: the phishing sim email said "complete this verification" and looked a bit odd. If I click and it's a sim, what happens? Any repercussions?

Priya Kapoor: Good question. If it's a simulated phish and you click, you'll get immediate non-punitive feedback and a 5-10 minute micro-training. We don't take punitive action for first-time failures. The goal is awareness. If you repeatedly click real test links after coaching, then security will follow up.

security-bot: Security training assigned: "New Hire Security Basics" -> Olivia Park. Due date: 2025-07-01. Link: https://training.redwood-internal/learn/nh-security-basics

Olivia Park: Hotspot worked, Jamf installed VPNConfig and compliance flipped to "compliant". Thanks Marcus. Last thing: who approves personal-device exceptions for Duo if I prefer not to register my phone?

Priya Kapoor: Manager approval is required for personal-device exceptions. Fill the personal-device exception form (internal KB) and cc your manager; security reviews and approves. If you need temporary access without Duo on personal phone, we can issue a one-time OTP token but that requires a security ticket and justification.

Olivia Park: Great, all set. I can access GitHub now and training shows up. Thanks everyone! :smile:
